result.title: Learning a Unified Cross-Model Semantic Dictionary via Gated Bottleneck Sparse Autoencoders
result.comment: The 40th Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
result.summary: Foundation models pretrained on similar data distributions tend to learn overlapping semantic structure, but their representations are distinct due to different model architecture, pretraining objectives and protocols. This prevents unified interpretability and cross-model feature reuse. Existing approaches extract interpretable concepts from individual models and align these concepts in a shared coordinate system using cross-reconstruction objectives, but the alignment only applies to latent coordinates while the concepts themselves remain model-specific and cannot be shared or reused. This paper introduces the Gated Bottleneck Sparse Autoencoder (GB-SAE), which casts unified cross-model interpretability as a representation factorization problem and solves it by simultaneously learning a unified shared dictionary and multiple private model-specific dictionaries via a gated bottleneck sparse autoencoder framework. The shared dictionary encodes the cross-model common semantic structure in unified concepts that are reusable across all participating models (and beyond), while each private dictionary comprises residual concepts that capture model-specific biases. We evaluate GB-SAE with distinct foundation models including ViT, SigLIP, DINOv2, and ConvNeXt. GB-SAE demonstrates superior reconstruction capability, unified and faithful interpretability, strong reusability and generalization to unseen models and downstream tasks. The code is available at https://github.com/trustAIoT/GB-SAE_NeurIPS.

AI.brief_summary: 提出门控瓶颈稀疏自编码器 GB-SAE，将跨模型可解释性表述为表示分解问题，同时学习一个可跨模型复用的共享字典和多个模型私有字典，并在 ViT、SigLIP、DINOv2、ConvNeXt 上评估重建、可解释性与泛化。
AI.relevance_reason: 共享字典与私有残差字典的分解思路，可能为 LVR 中区分跨模型共有的视觉语义与模型特有成分（如分析 latent 相似度中的内容与结构因素）提供可供核查的表示分解线索，但原文不涉及推理、生成或证据使用。
